# Serdes Fight Club

Serdes Fight Club is a martial arts and fitness training gym in Heraklion, Crete. The club offers MMA, kickboxing, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Fit Box, Pilates, and kids' classes.

## Official pages

- [Homepage](https://serdesfightclub.gr/): training overview, programmes, coaches, schedule, and contact details.
- [Sitemap](https://serdesfightclub.gr/sitemap.xml): list of public URLs.
- [Robots policy](https://serdesfightclub.gr/robots.txt): crawler directives.
